## Support that continues beyond the offer.
Most staffing partners disappear after the placement fee clears. The two highlighted below are why we don't, trust doesn't come with a closing date.
### RecriAuth
![](http://www.recrivio.com/assets/BackgroundVerification-D1Xzm-pD.svg)
#### Background Verification
Identity, employment, and education checks, cleared before day one, 24–48 hour turnaround, not a bolt-on vendor with its own 5-day queue.
![](http://www.recrivio.com/assets/ContinuousMonitoring-vW-tscor.svg)
#### Continuous Monitoring
Most vendors stop watching the moment verification clears. We keep checking for moonlighting and new criminal or court records after day one, risk doesn't get to sit invisible.
![](http://www.recrivio.com/assets/ComplianceMonitoring-CwQdWPVg.svg)
#### Compliance Monitoring
Regulatory changes get tracked and documentation kept current automatically, not something you find out about at your next audit.
### Talent Solutions
![](http://www.recrivio.com/assets/ScalingSupport-CBreBRQ1.svg)
#### Scaling Support
From your 5th hire to your 500th, the same account team and platform scale with you, no re-onboarding a new vendor as you grow.
![](http://www.recrivio.com/assets/RecruitmentinsightsIcon-DexPfFvm.svg)
#### Recruitment insights
Real-time pipeline visibility in your dashboard, not a weekly status email pulled from someone's spreadsheet.
![](http://www.recrivio.com/assets/Offboarding-vT7rbtdD.svg)
#### Offboarding
Exit documentation, compliance, and offboarding handled end-to-end, the relationship doesn't stop when someone leaves either.
